movie.title: Buffet Infinity
movie.overview: In a series of cheap, locally produced TV commercials, small business owners rival the looming threat of Buffet Infinity. As Buffet Infinity endlessly expands and grows, engulfing everything in its path, a sinister conspiracy unfolds at the margins, and unfathomable powers begin to seep into the vulnerable community of Westridge County, Alberta.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When an all-consuming corporate entity called Buffet Infinity threatens to engulf Westridge County, local business owners fight back through low-budget TV commercials as a sinister supernatural conspiracy takes root.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In Westridge County, Alberta, small business owners turn to cheap, locally produced television ads to combat the existential threat of Buffet Infinity. As this mysterious entity endlessly expands and threatens to absorb everything in its path, a dark conspiracy unfolds on the margins of the community. Unfathomable, eerie forces begin to seep into the vulnerable town, blurring the lines between corporate greed, surreal horror, and local survival. Ultimately, the townspeople must confront both economic ruin and otherworldly powers to protect their home.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The quiet community of Westridge County, Alberta, faces an unprecedented crisis when Buffet Infinity, an ever-expanding commercial phenomenon, begins absorbing local enterprises. Desperate to keep their livelihoods alive, a eclectic group of small business owners band together to launch a series of absurdly cheap, home-made television commercials to rally public support. However, what begins as a quirky corporate rivalry quickly devolves into a nightmare as Buffet Infinity's growth violates the laws of nature and economics alike. Strange phenomena begin occurring around the margins of the broadcasts, signaling that a deeper, sinister conspiracy is at play. As the entity's reach threatens to engulf the entire region, vulnerable residents start exhibiting strange behaviors influenced by unfathomable forces. Local leaders and eccentric commercial stars attempt to investigate the true origins of the terrifying enterprise before their community is completely erased. The struggle shifts from a desperate marketing campaign to a surreal fight for human identity and sanity against an incomprehensible menace. In the end, the line between cheesy local advertising and apocalyptic dread dissolves into a high-stakes standoff for the soul of Westridge County.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of Westridge County, Alberta, this surreal blend of comedy, horror, and drama explores the uncanny collision of small-town commerce and cosmic dread. The story centers on a tight-knit community forced to reckon with Buffet Infinity, an endlessly growing corporate juggernaut that threatens to devour local businesses and land alike. Armed with nothing more than cheap video cameras and local broadcast airtime, an eccentric cast of business owners produce a series of low-budget TV commercials in a desperate bid to hold onto their livelihoods. But beneath the comedic surface of late-night ads and local rivalries lies a creeping, sinister conspiracy. As Buffet Infinity's expansion accelerates, mysterious forces leak into the fabric of the county, testing the resilience, sanity, and unity of its residents in a battle against an all-consuming force.

story_structure.climax: The local business owners and residents are forced to confront the mysterious forces behind Buffet Infinity as the conspiracy reaches a critical breaking point, threatening the entire existence of Westridge County.
story_structure.conflict: The surreal, ever-expanding threat of 'Buffet Infinity' emerges, rapidly engulfing local establishments and challenging the survival of small businesses across the county.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the confrontation, the community faces the lingering physical and supernatural consequences of the expansion, forever altering the landscape of Westridge County.
story_structure.introduction: In Westridge County, Alberta, local business owners broadcast cheap, quirky TV commercials to promote their shops, establishing the close-knit, everyday community prior to any disruption.
story_structure.risingAction: As Buffet Infinity's footprint spreads, odd occurrences and a sinister conspiracy begin to surface at the margins, while unfathomable powers seep into the increasingly vulnerable community.
